correctness.rationale: The source equation is exactly equivalent to \(a s(a)+b s(b)=2ab\). The cases \(a=1\) and \(a=p\) are completely eliminated by proper-divisor-sum bounds and divisibility. For two prime powers with one common base, a modulo-prime argument excludes unequal exponents and \(s(p^r)<p^r\) excludes equal exponents. For distinct bases, reduction modulo each full prime power forces contradictory strict inequalities.
